flagged.evidence: Proof 4.1 says the upper and lower bridge arcs carrying the punctures each have endpoints on opposite sides of C. Each therefore contributes one endpoint to each S_i, while every other bridge arc contributes either zero or two endpoints to S_i. Hence r_i=|L∩S_i| is even, contradicting the step's assertion that it is odd. Proof 5.1 then sets n_i=(r_i+1)/2, which is not an integer bridge count; the lower-bound inference in 6.1 is unproved.
